evidence.reason: The dependency scan is explicitly intended to catch co-installed units that can affect the selected unit (see the comment at lines 104-108 about `Wants=crq-tick.service`). `PropagatesStopTo=crq-tick.service` is the same kind of control path: stopping the co-installed unit stops the selected unit. Because `DEPENDENCY_RE` omits both `PropagatesStopTo=` and its inverse `StopPropagatedFrom=`, discovery can miss that path and report `supported=True`. Adding the two alternatives is the smallest compatible correctness fix; no owner decision is needed.
